description: This file contains unit tests for the AWS SQS streaming provider within an Orleans application, including configuration, initialization, and various test cases for streaming scenarios.

classes.name: SQSStreamTests
classes.description: Contains tests for SQS streaming provider with various producer/consumer configurations, setup and teardown logic, and test execution methods.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with SQS and DynamoDB storage options.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test runner before tests run.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deletes used SQS queues after tests complete.

methods.name: SQS_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests a one-to-one producer/consumer scenario with grains.

methods.name: SQS_02_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a scenario with a producer grain and a consumer client.

methods.name: SQS_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests a scenario with a producer client and a consumer grain.

methods.name: SQS_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a scenario with a producer and consumer both as clients.

methods.name: SQS_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many-producer-to-many-consumer grains configuration.

methods.name: SQS_06_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many-producer grains to many consumer clients configuration.

methods.name: SQS_07_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many producer clients to many consumer grains configuration.

methods.name: SQS_08_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many producer and consumer clients configuration.

methods.name: SQS_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many grains both producing and consuming streams.

methods.name: SQS_10_ManySame_ManyConsumerGrainsManyProducerGrains
methods.description: Tests many grains acting as both producers and consumers.

methods.name: SQS_11_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many producer grains with many consumer clients.

methods.name: SQS_12_ManySame_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many producer clients with many consumer grains.

methods.name: SQS_13_SameGrain_ConsumerFirstProducerLater
methods.description: Tests the pattern where consumer is started before producer in the same grain.

methods.name: SQS_14_SameGrain_ProducerFirstConsumerLater
methods.description: Tests the pattern where producer is started before consumer in the same grain.

methods.name: SQS_15_ConsumeAtProducersRequest
methods.description: Tests consuming messages exactly at producer request time.

methods.name: SQS_16_MultipleStreams_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple streams with many grains, both producer and consumer.

methods.name: SQS_17_MultipleStreams_1J_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple streams with additional silo start, for more complex scenarios.
